# dericBI

> dericBI is a data analytics business in Kenya founded by Deric Marangu. It builds business dashboards and reports (Power BI, Excel), does data cleaning and analysis (Python, SQL), and offers data-skills training for individuals and teams.

Primary site: https://dericbi.vercel.app/

## For businesses
- [Business solutions](https://dericbi.vercel.app/home.html): dashboards, reporting and analytics for organizations
- [Services](https://dericbi.vercel.app/services.html): what dericBI offers and how engagements work
- [Projects](https://dericbi.vercel.app/my-projects.html): examples of completed work
- [Contact](https://dericbi.vercel.app/contact.html): ways to reach dericBI

## For learners
- [dericBI Skills (Tujengane)](https://dericbiskills.vercel.app/): data-skills training for individuals

## About
- [About dericBI](https://dericbi.vercel.app/about.html): who runs dericBI and why
- [Deric Marangu, founder (portfolio)](https://dericmarangu.vercel.app/): data analyst and software developer portfolio
- [Terms](https://dericbi.vercel.app/terms.html): terms of service
